content.text: Section 18 contains a full insurance clause that meets or exceeds every element of the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 imposes the insurance obligations on Vendor (Brightline) and matches our preferred position on every material term: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M (appropriate as Vendor hosts Customer Data), and workers' compensation as required by law, all maintained through the term plus one year. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, primary coverage, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities — all favourable to us. No deviation; nothing to redline.
